notes.title: New XP system
notes.content:
Hi breakfast lovers!

We've just uploaded a new update of Breaking Fast.

The most important change is a revision of how many experience points you get after each race/tournament. We heard from some of you that the progression was a bit slow, so we've changed it so that you can gain access to locked content faster than before.

In addition to this, this update includes the following:

- You can now restart a tournament when the tournament finishes. There is no need to come back to the main menu to start the same tournament.
- Bug fixes that prevent crashes when you invite (or are invited) to an online game.
- Some minor stability issues are fixed.

We're working on exciting things, so we'll get back to you soon. For the moment, if you have any comment, suggestion or feedback, let us know on the game forum.

Enjoy!

notes.title: New Update: Steam Cloud and IA improvements
notes.content:
Hi breakfast lovers!

After hearing your feedback, we've updated Breaking Fast in order to include, among others, the following new features:

- Cloud Save integration so that you can have your progress on any other PC. Now you can take your best breakfast wherever you want!

- Revised and improved Artificial Intelligence to make the CPU players more fair and fun than they are now. Nonetheless, you'll still have to dodge lots of punches and superattacks!

- Stability fixes to prevent some infrequent crashes.

- Localization fixes in several languages.

We have great plans to continue improving the game, and we're always eager to hear your thoughts, so let us know what you think and what you'd improve! 

Enjoy your food!

Breaking Fast Team

notes.title: New patch to address community feedback
notes.content:
Hello Breaking Fast community!

Thank you for all your videos, comments, and screenshots since the release of Breaking Fast - we really value them! 

We've been watching carefully all your videos and taking notes about your suggestions, so we made a few changes in this first patch to address some of the issues raised.

[list]
    [*]New sound bars have been added for both the sound effects and the background music, so you can know adjust them to the volume you like, specially useful for all the youtubers out there!
    [*]Fix online game creation occasionally failing to register the game server if you were searching for a game seconds before trying to create a new room.
[/list]

We constantly keep an eye on the Breaking Fast community to make sure you get the best experience, so if you have any other suggestions or ideas, let us know in the forums!


The Breaking Fast Team

notes.title: Breaking Fast now available with a 20% off!
notes.content:
It's being a long and intense journey but we're finally there. Breaking Fast, the most awesome and delicious racing and brawling game ever, is now live on Steam!

Thanks to all our followers and breakfast lovers and if you're not part of our community yet, we encourage you to give it a try: you won't see your breakfast the same way anymore.

We also opened some forums where you can post your ideas, suggestions or problems. We'll look at them carefully in order to provide you with the best experience.

Have fun!

Breaking Fast Team

notes.title: Welcome to the most delicious community!
notes.content:
Hi all!

It's our pleasure to welcome you on our official Steam store page.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28814161/b87966eb56f8ce3a9b8956f85292d4bdd7260942.png[/img]

Our goal is to create a delicious and fun community that enjoys together the fantastic [strike]menus[/strike] food races we're preparing with love and care.

The more people in the Breaking Fast community, the bigger the online fun will be, so we kindly ask you to spread the word about this game. Tell your family, your friends, your colleagues, your pets (well, actually this last is not necessary unless they can grab a controller).

Let's start this amazing journey today and have fun on our way!
 
Ah! And we'll disclose the official release date of Breaking Fast very soon over this week, so stay tuned!

The Breaking Fast Team
